g.text: $ ./demo/verify-receipt.sh
PRAETORE receipt verification demo
!! DEMO/TEST ONLY: fixed public seeds, fictitious data. Never use these keys. !!
[1/4] Generate DEMO/TEST-ONLY Ed25519 key from fixed seed
key_id : DEMO-ONLY-not-for-real-use-v1
execution public key : e72c28fe718e3a30afc47438da779d508d2dad5a265fafeb4f377e1d57fb098c
evidence attester public key : b4740ba4e0f7e0576f11e8149dbbb2529c212213db679831fb5d1b221e84552d
[2/4] Issue and sign a fictitious receipt
receipt : 4398 bytes, authorization=allowed, execution=executed
private keys dropped; only public keys and receipt are kept
[3/4] Verify with public keys only
PASS valid receipt verified
[4/4] Alter one byte and verify again
PASS 4a signature byte changed: rejected
error: InvalidSignature ("execution attestation signature is invalid")
PASS 4b output byte changed (rows 3 -> 4): rejected
error: InvalidPayload ("execution attestation payload is invalid")
PASS 4c evidence attester signature byte changed: rejected
error: InvalidEvidenceSignature ("receipt evidence attester signature is missing or invalid")
RESULT: PASS (valid receipt accepted, tampered receipts rejected)
